The near-Aleppo edition

These pages are an example HTML edition based on the near-Aleppo dataset. The edition has each book's text with MAM's notes beside it, as MAM-with-doc does.

  • Torah: Genesis Exodus Levit Numbers Deuter
  • NevRish: Joshua Judges 1Samuel 2Samuel 1Kings 2Kings
  • NevAx: Isaiah Jeremiah Ezekiel Hosea Joel Amos Obadiah Jonah Micah Nahum Habakkuk Tsefaniah Haggai Zechariah Malachi
  • SifEm: Psalms Proverbs Job
  • XamMeg: Song of Songs Ruth Lamentations Ecclesiastes Esther
  • KetAx: Daniel Ezra Nehemiah 1Chronicles 2Chronicles

The pointed ketiv is shown as the primary text; the pointed qere appears above it; both are enclosed in a rounded box or “cartouche”.

Features of interest in NAEE

MAM’s doc-notes have been adjusted in some cases where the note’s “target”, or subject, differs between near-Aleppo and MAM. Orphan vowels and accents—marks associated with no letter or whose association is unclear—are shown on placeholder letters (alef, vav, or dalet) between double guillemets.

Every paseq glyph is shown as MAM-with-doc shows a legarmeh, a thin space and then the glyph, since near-Aleppo intentionally drops MAM's distinctions between paseq and legarmeh.

Near-Aleppo is derived from Miqra according to the Masorah (MAM), whose license and source attribution are these:
